name: feedback-panel-list
for: The runtime's /feedback panel, list view, which `1` on the card opens: a heavy rule across the pane, the title 'Feedback drafts', the drafts of this session and of others, and 'Enter to review · d to discard · Esc to close'. It REPLACES the composer, so there is none on screen, and the finished-turn line above it used to make the state read say idle with an empty composer. A stray key is not harmless here (Enter opens a draft, d discards one). This case pins unknown, no prompt: a person is deciding what to do with their drafts. Only the panel's frame is kept by redaction; the draft titles are other sessions' and are discarded.
redactedFrom: real capture of an 80-column, 24-row pane running the runtime with drafts on, on the panel `1` opens, redacted by corpus-redact; the status text is kept because it is, whole, the runtime's own vocabulary, and every row of the draft above it is the agent's and is discarded
